create_CountingIterator: create a CountingIterator wrapping an iterable to track elements consumed and support skip and take
create_EpochBatchIterator: create an EpochBatchIterator for multi-epoch dataset iteration with sharding, shuffling, and state serialization
create_GroupedIterator: create a GroupedIterator that chunks an iterable into fixed-size groups of items
create_ShardedIterator: create a ShardedIterator to split an iterable across multiple shards for distributed data loading
create_BufferedIterator: create a BufferedIterator with a background consumer thread to prefetch and buffer data from an iterable
